name: anypod
description: Private podcast RSS feed aggregator and web player hosted on Cloudflare Pages/Workers

scripts.dev:prod: npm run build && wrangler pages dev public/dist --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 8788
scripts.deploy: node scripts/verify-deploy.js && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public/dist --project-name anypod --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy-staging: node scripts/verify-deploy.js && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy public/dist --project-name anypod --branch=staging --commit-dirty=true
